title.zh: EVE 学院：安全等级与犯罪

blocks.en: Crime is just a fact of life for the citizens of New Eden and, for some,
blocks.zh: 对新伊甸的居民来说，犯罪不过是生活的一部分，而对某些人来说，

blocks.en: a perfectly legitimate business strategy.
blocks.zh: 这更是一种完全正当的生意经。

blocks.en: CONCORD is the entity responsible for keeping the peace between capsuleers;
blocks.zh: 统合部（CONCORD）是负责维护克隆飞行员之间和平的机构；

blocks.en: each empire employs their own police forces as well,
blocks.zh: 各大帝国也有自己的警察部队，

blocks.en: however, all of these forces have limited reach.
blocks.zh: 但所有这些力量的触角都有限。

blocks.en: No system in New Eden is completely safe.
blocks.zh: 新伊甸没有哪个星系是绝对安全的。

blocks.en: New Eden is split into three categories, based on security level.
blocks.zh: 新伊甸按安全等级分为三类。

blocks.en: Systems with a security value from 0.5 to 1 are known as High-Security Space
blocks.zh: 安全等级在 0.5 到 1 之间的星系称为高安全区，

blocks.en: or Highsec for short.
blocks.zh: 简称高安（Highsec）。

blocks.en: Aggressive actions against other capsuleers in Highsec
blocks.zh: 在高安对其他克隆飞行员采取攻击行为

blocks.en: will elicit retaliation by CONCORD,
blocks.zh: 会招致统合部的报复，

blocks.en: resulting in swift destruction of the offending party.
blocks.zh: 肇事者会被迅速摧毁。

blocks.en: In systems with a lower security status,
blocks.zh: 在安全等级较低的星系，

blocks.en: CONCORD's response is delayed.
blocks.zh: 统合部的响应会有延迟。

blocks.en: A fact that some of the more dangerous Capsuleers may use to their advantage.
blocks.zh: 一些较危险的克隆飞行员可能会利用这一点。

blocks.en: Outside of Highsec and beyond the reach of CONCORD
blocks.zh: 在高安之外、统合部鞭长莫及的地方，

blocks.en: are regions of Low Security space,
blocks.zh: 是低安全区，

blocks.en: shown in your HUD as systems between 0.4 and 0.1.
blocks.zh: 在 HUD 上显示为 0.4 到 0.1 的星系。

blocks.en: In Low Security space,
blocks.zh: 在低安，

blocks.en: NPC pirates become stronger
blocks.zh: NPC 海盗变得更强，

blocks.en: and PvE content is much more lucrative than highsec.
blocks.zh: PvE 内容的收益也比高安高得多。

blocks.en: However, Capsuleers may freely engage one another
blocks.zh: 但克隆飞行员之间可以自由交战，

blocks.en: without the risk of CONCORD intervening.
blocks.zh: 不用担心统合部介入。

blocks.en: While CONCORD does not have response ships in these systems,
blocks.zh: 虽然统合部在这些星系没有响应舰船，

blocks.en: aggressive action will result in a loss of a capsuleer's personal security standing
blocks.zh: 但攻击行为会导致克隆飞行员的个人安全等级下降，

blocks.en: and the stationary sentry guns on stargates and stations
blocks.zh: 而星门和空间站上固定的岗哨炮

blocks.en: will fire upon those who break the law.
blocks.zh: 会向违法者开火。

blocks.en: Systems with a security status of 0.0 and below are vast nullsec regions,
blocks.zh: 安全等级为 0.0 及以下的星系属于广阔的 00 区，

blocks.en: the majority of which are owned by massive player alliances.
blocks.zh: 其中大部分由大型玩家联盟占领。

blocks.en: Crimes committed in nullsec go unpunished by CONCORD,
blocks.zh: 在 00 区犯罪不会受到统合部的惩罚，

blocks.en: and involved pilots do not lose security standings for aggression.
blocks.zh: 参与攻击的飞行员也不会损失安全等级。

blocks.en: New mechanics also become available,
blocks.zh: 这里还有一些新的机制，

blocks.en: including the use of interdiction spheres, commonly referred to as bubbles.
blocks.zh: 包括使用拦截泡（Interdiction Sphere），通常简称「泡泡」。

blocks.en: Bubbles may be deployed by Capsuleers to prevent ships from warping away
blocks.zh: 克隆飞行员可以部署泡泡，阻止舰船跃迁离开

blocks.en: or reaching their intended destination.
blocks.zh: 或到达预定目的地。

blocks.en: The security status of systems on your route can be seen directly on your HUD.
blocks.zh: 航线上各星系的安全等级可以直接在 HUD 上看到。

blocks.en: Once you have chosen a destination,
blocks.zh: 选好目的地后，

blocks.en: colored blocks which represent the security of each system along the way
blocks.zh: 屏幕左上角会显示一排彩色方块，

blocks.en: are displayed in the upper left corner of the screen.
blocks.zh: 代表沿途每个星系的安全等级。

blocks.en: You can mouseover each of these to see more details for any particular jump.
blocks.zh: 鼠标悬停在方块上，可以查看任意一跳的详细信息。

blocks.en: By clicking the A icon above your route,
blocks.zh: 点击航线上方的 A 图标，

blocks.en: you are also able to set your path
blocks.zh: 还可以设置航线

blocks.en: to prefer shorter, safer, or even less secure systems.
blocks.zh: 优先选择更短、更安全，甚至更不安全的星系。

blocks.en: Engaging in criminal activity in EVE
blocks.zh: 在 EVE 中从事犯罪活动

blocks.en: will result in specific flags being applied to you.
blocks.zh: 会让你被打上特定的标记。

blocks.en: These flags are referred to as "timers"
blocks.zh: 这些标记称为「计时器（timer）」，

blocks.en: and determine who can legally shoot you when they're active.
blocks.zh: 决定了在计时期间谁可以合法地攻击你。

blocks.en: A Suspect Timer is triggered when engaging in most forms of criminal activity
blocks.zh: 大多数形式的犯罪活动都会触发嫌犯计时（Suspect Timer），

blocks.en: such as shooting at another player in Lowsec,
blocks.zh: 例如在低安攻击其他玩家，

blocks.en: or stealing someone else's loot in Highsec.
blocks.zh: 或在高安偷拿别人的战利品。

blocks.en: Suspects can be freely engaged by other capsuleers in any system,
blocks.zh: 在被标记为嫌犯期间，

blocks.en: regardless of security status,
blocks.zh: 无论星系安全等级如何，

blocks.en: for as long as they are flagged as a suspect.
blocks.zh: 其他克隆飞行员都可以在任何星系自由攻击嫌犯。

blocks.en: Should you choose to shoot a suspect,
blocks.zh: 如果你选择攻击嫌犯，

blocks.en: CONCORD will not intervene and no security status will be lost.
blocks.zh: 统合部不会介入，你也不会损失安全等级。

blocks.en: A Criminal Timer is reserved for more serious offenses
blocks.zh: 罪犯计时（Criminal Timer）则针对更严重的罪行，

blocks.en: such as shooting at a player in Highsec,
blocks.zh: 例如在高安攻击玩家，

blocks.en: or destroying a Capsule in Lowsec.
blocks.zh: 或在低安摧毁太空舱。

blocks.en: Having a criminal timer while present in Highsec
blocks.zh: 在高安带着罪犯计时，

blocks.en: will result in CONCORD quickly destroying the offender.
blocks.zh: 统合部会迅速摧毁违法者。

blocks.en: A Limited Engagement Timer is created when attacking a player
blocks.zh: 攻击被标记为嫌犯或罪犯的玩家时，

blocks.en: flagged as a Suspect or a Criminal.
blocks.zh: 会产生有限交战计时（Limited Engagement Timer）。

blocks.en: This timer will last for 5 minutes,
blocks.zh: 该计时持续 5 分钟，

blocks.en: and allows for combat between yourself and one other pilot.
blocks.zh: 允许你和另一名飞行员之间相互交战。

blocks.en: You can have multiple Limited Engagement Timers on at any one time.
blocks.zh: 你可以同时拥有多个有限交战计时。

blocks.en: Engaging other capsuleers in any security level
blocks.zh: 在任何安全等级的星系与其他克隆飞行员交战，

blocks.en: will also result in a 60 second 'Combat Timer',
blocks.zh: 还会产生 60 秒的「战斗计时（Combat Timer）」，

blocks.en: denoted by a red chain-link icon.
blocks.zh: 以红色锁链图标表示。

blocks.en: While this timer is active, you cannot dock or take gates.
blocks.zh: 该计时激活期间，你无法停靠或使用星门。

blocks.en: Keep this in mind if you think you may need to make a hasty retreat.
blocks.zh: 如果你觉得可能需要紧急撤退，务必记住这一点。

blocks.en: Your ship's safety settings will prevent you from committing crimes by default,
blocks.zh: 默认情况下，舰船的安全设置会阻止你犯罪，

blocks.en: however, should you so choose,
blocks.zh: 不过，如果你愿意，

blocks.en: you can lower your safety settings to allow you to take illegal actions,
blocks.zh: 也可以降低安全设置，允许自己采取非法行动，

blocks.en: if you are willing to deal with the consequences.
blocks.zh: 前提是你愿意承担后果。

blocks.en: Click on the small icon to the upper left of your capacitor
blocks.zh: 点击电容左上方的小图标，

blocks.en: to find the options for Full, Partial, or Disabled safety settings.
blocks.zh: 可以找到完全、部分和禁用三档安全设置。

blocks.en: With safety set to green, you cannot commit illegal actions,
blocks.zh: 安全设置为绿色时，你无法采取非法行动，

blocks.en: preventing you from accidentally flagging yourself as a suspect or criminal.
blocks.zh: 避免意外把自己标记为嫌犯或罪犯。

blocks.en: Partial, or yellow safety
blocks.zh: 部分安全，即黄色，

blocks.en: will allow you to partake in actions that would generate a suspect timer,
blocks.zh: 允许你采取会产生嫌犯计时的行动，

blocks.en: such as stealing from someone's loot container in highsec,
blocks.zh: 例如在高安偷拿别人战利品容器里的东西，

blocks.en: or shooting at non-suspects in lowsec.
blocks.zh: 或在低安攻击非嫌犯目标。

blocks.en: When safety is set to red,
blocks.zh: 安全设置为红色时，

blocks.en: all safety controls are disabled,
blocks.zh: 所有安全限制都会解除，

blocks.en: allowing you to shoot Capsules in Lowsec or even other players in Highsec.
blocks.zh: 你可以在低安攻击太空舱，甚至在高安攻击其他玩家。

blocks.en: But note that CONCORD may quickly respond to free you from your ship.
blocks.zh: 但要注意，统合部可能会迅速赶来，把你「解放」出你的船。

blocks.en: If you find yourself living a life of crime,
blocks.zh: 如果你走上了犯罪道路，

blocks.en: you may find your personal security status dropping quickly.
blocks.zh: 可能会发现自己的个人安全等级下降得很快。

blocks.en: This value represents your relationship with the faction police of New Eden.
blocks.zh: 这个数值代表你与新伊甸各势力警察的关系。

blocks.en: Security Status is gained by killing NPC pirates
blocks.zh: 击杀 NPC 海盗可以提升安全等级，

blocks.en: and lowered by committing offenses in Highsec and Lowsec.
blocks.zh: 在高安和低安犯罪则会降低安全等级。

blocks.en: If this value drops below -2.0,
blocks.zh: 如果该数值低于 -2.0，

blocks.en: then faction police will attack you in some Highsec Systems.
blocks.zh: 势力警察会在部分高安星系攻击你。

blocks.en: At -5.0, you will be classified as an Outlaw and may be attacked anywhere,
blocks.zh: 到了 -5.0，你会被列为亡命之徒（Outlaw），在任何地方都可能遭到攻击，

blocks.en: without any protection from CONCORD or Lowsec gate guns.
blocks.zh: 不再受统合部或低安星门炮的任何保护。

blocks.en: Should you ever wish to atone for your crimes,
blocks.zh: 如果你想为自己的罪行赎罪，

blocks.en: you can turn in security tags to the appropriate authority,
blocks.zh: 可以向相应的机构上交安全标签（Security Tag），

blocks.en: but be warned,
blocks.zh: 但要注意，

blocks.en: they come at a high cost.
blocks.zh: 代价不菲。

blocks.en: Understanding the laws of New Eden is a key foundation
blocks.zh: 了解新伊甸的法律，是每一位有志的雇佣兵

blocks.en: upon which any aspiring Soldier of Fortune may begin their career.
blocks.zh: 开启职业生涯的重要基础。

blocks.en: From here, it's up to you,
blocks.zh: 接下来就看你自己了，

blocks.en: whether you choose to make your way in low security space,
blocks.zh: 是选择在低安闯荡，

blocks.en: or avoid the law entirely by carving out a path in nullsecurity
blocks.zh: 还是在 00 区或虫洞空间开辟道路，

blocks.en: or wormhole space.
blocks.zh: 彻底远离法律的约束。

blocks.en: Wherever your adventures take you,
blocks.zh: 无论冒险把你带向何方，

blocks.en: knowing the rules of engagement for the space you are in
blocks.zh: 了解所在空间的交战规则

blocks.en: will serve you well.
blocks.zh: 都会让你受益匪浅。
